products.name: Free homepage accessibility summary
products.description: Short summary (about 4 pages) of an automated WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA scan of the homepage (axe-core + scripted keyboard check): issue counts by severity and the top problems with their fixes. Sent to anyone who replies.

products.name: Accessibility Audit Report (up to 10 key pages)
products.description: Automated axe-core scan of up to 10 key pages (home, product/service, contact, cart/booking, about) at desktop and mobile widths, plus scripted Tab-key traversal (focus order, visible focus, traps), 320px reflow, headings, alt text, labels and landmarks. Every issue in plain English with the exact element, WCAG criterion, severity and a concrete code fix; PDF + HTML + JSON of every failing element; explicit list of what automated testing cannot cover. Not legal advice and not a compliance certification.

products.name: Monthly re-scan monitoring
products.description: The same pages re-scanned every month with a short change report: what was fixed, what is new, what remains. Cancel any time.
